title: Marketing Lead
description:
This is a remote position.

Join one of the Philippines’ fastest-growing tech companies! Open to Philippine-based candidates only.

About Us
Full Scale is a fully remote-first company that helps businesses build dedicated teams of skilled software engineers. We make it easier for growing companies to find, onboard, and retain high-performing software talent.

The Role

As the Marketing Lead, you will be the driving force behind our go-to-market strategy, product messaging, and brand presence. This is a roll-up-your-sleeves, player-coach role-you’ll develop the marketing strategy while actively executing campaigns, creating content, and building the workflows that drive demand for our enterprise SaaS products.

You’ll bridge the gap between strategy and execution, taking ownership of how we communicate our value to enterprise decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

• Hands-on Execution & Strategy: Act as a player-coach, developing and executing a comprehensive marketing and go-to-market strategy to drive pipeline growth for our enterprise SaaS and platform solutions.

• Product Marketing & Messaging: Own product positioning, messaging, and value propositions for enterprise audiences. Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling, benefit-driven messaging.

• Content Generation: Write, produce, and edit high-quality marketing content across the customer journey, including LinkedIn content, thought leadership, blog posts, website copy, email sequences, case studies, ad copy, and webinar scripts.

• Design Sensibility: Apply a discerning eye for design across all marketing touchpoints. Ensure that visual assets, presentations, landing pages, and marketing collateral are polished, professional, and aligned with our brand identity.

• Customer Persona Development: Conduct deep research to understand enterprise stakeholders, their pain points, buying journeys, and decision-making processes. Develop and refine customer personas to inform messaging and campaign strategy.

• Messaging & Content Calendar: Create, manage, and execute a cohesive messaging and content calendar, ensuring a consistent and compelling narrative across channels week over week.

• LinkedIn & Content-Led Demand Generation: Develop and execute content-led demand-generation strategies, with a strong focus on LinkedIn, organic thought leadership, targeted content, and engagement with enterprise audiences.

• Multi-Channel Campaign Management: Lead the end-to-end execution of marketing campaigns. Own the promotion, registration, and follow-up strategies for webinars and other content-led campaigns, while coordinating targeted outreach across relevant channels.

• Demand Generation & Paid Advertising: Build, launch, and optimize demand-generation campaigns, including PPC and paid advertising, to complement organic and content-led initiatives and drive high-quality enterprise leads.

• Landing Pages & Conversion: Design, build, test, and refine high-converting landing pages tailored to specific campaigns, applying strong design and conversion principles to optimize the user experience.

• Analytics & Reporting: Implement complete analytics and conversion tracking across marketing touchpoints. Monitor campaign performance, analyze KPIs, and use data-driven insights to continuously optimize content, campaigns, pipeline contribution, and marketing spend.

• Proven experience in B2B Enterprise SaaS or enterprise technology marketing.

• Strong ServiceNow / enterprise platform fluency, with experience or working knowledge of areas such as UI Builder, integrations, custom components, portals, workflows, or related enterprise architecture.

• Proven experience in Product Marketing (PMM) or owning a marketing function, including positioning, messaging, customer personas, buyer journeys, or go-to-market planning.

• Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on player-coach, combining strategic thinking with direct execution.

title: Account Executive, Platform
description:
About Finix

Finix is building the global operating system for fintech, starting with payments. From startups to publicly traded companies, Finix processes tens of billions of dollars annually both in-store and online. Finix was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco.
To date Finix has raised over $200M, including a $75M Series C led by Acrew Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners and backed by American Express Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Homebrew, Inspired Capital, Visa, and others
About the Role:
As an Account Executive on our Platform team, you will own the full sales cycle for Finix 's payments products, selling to platforms and ISVs of all sizes. You will lead the sales cycle with founders, CEOs, CTOs, CFOs, and VP/Director-level functional leads. You will drive sales strategy by owning every stage of the cycle from discovery to close, including the cross-functional work to develop the customer strategy and contribute to broader revenue initiatives.

Payments are core to the strategy of the vertical SaaS companies we partner with, and Finix 's tools let software platforms monetize payments while keeping their SaaS fees competitive. You'll work with founders and executives to understand their business and help them embed and monetize payments.
You Will:

• Own and manage the full sales cycle from hunting/discovery to close for software platforms and ISVs.

• Develop relationships with executives at software companies, along with the technical and non-executive stakeholders brought into deals.

• Share prospect feedback with cross-functional teams, refine our Ideal Customer Profile, and act on insights from your knowledge of our platform customers.

• Contribute to team projects focused on developing and refining our sales process and playbooks.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to help drive product strategy and operations.

• Work closely with our Implementation, Product, and Payment Ops teams to ensure long-term customer success.

You Are:

• Driven to consistently exceed goals and expectations.

• A go-getter with a bias toward action and the ability to produce results in fast-paced, ambiguous situations.

• Proactive, improving existing processes and developing best practices.

• A strategic negotiator with a passion for closing deals.

• Curious about prospects, their needs, and how Finix can help.

• Energetic, bringing a positive attitude to everything you do.

You Have:

• Proven ability to exceed sales targets.

• 3+ years of experience in a consultative SaaS selling environment or business development, preferably with a technical product.

• 1+ years of experience in fintech, ideally selling payments to ISVs or software platforms preferred

• Strong communication, research, and presentation skills.

• Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Google Suite, and other sales tools.

• A strong desire and ability to grow within Finix .

Finix is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected class.
Role: Account Executive III/IV
Level: IC3/4
Location: Remote
Base Salary Range: $100,000/year to $150,000/year + equity + benefits
Total On-Target-Earnings: $200,000/year to $300,000/year
Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries at our headquarters in San Francisco, California. Individual pay is determined by work location, job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

As an experienced online educator (LINC Fellow), the candidate will work as an independent contractor of LINC and serve a diverse international student body for Undergraduate-level programs studying at premier Australian and Asian universities. The candidate must possess strong knowledge of mental health care and recovery-oriented practice, with expertise in consumer rights, self-determination, collaborative decision-making, and evidence-based approaches to complex mental ill-health. Key Skills Required

• Recovery-oriented mental health care

• Mental health consumer rights and advocacy

• Consumer movement and service delivery

• Self-determination and collaborative decision-making

• Strength-based practice

• Stigma and cultural perspectives on mental illness

• Evidence-based mental health interventions

• Complex mental ill-health support

• Confidentiality and privacy in mental health care

• Consumer and carer collaboration

• Registered Nurse or Midwife (AHPRA registration) or Registered Mental Health Practising Nurse and knowledge of unit content.

• PhD and/or Master Degree in Nursing or relevant field (i.e. health-related) plus 5 years' relevant teaching, research and/or professional experience at the PG level in the last 10 years

• Full rights to work within Australia.

• An Australian Business Number or ABN as a sole trader, or of the entity that will contract with LINC.

• Empathetic, ambitious, warm and outgoing personality willing to work closely with people from diverse cultures;

• Proficient in English language; excellent oral and written communication

• Must possess a working laptop and have access to high-speed (>10 MBPS) stable internet connection;

• Ability to quickly learn and use technology platforms for interacting with students, including the host university’s LMS and LINCtrac (training on these platforms will be provided).

The candidate needs to be available between 5 pm to 10 pm every day.

• Support in learning skills like academic writing, research and time management;

• Guidance on relevant reference material;

• Assessment marking with long-form feedback

• Management of discussion forums; and

• Proactive, prompt and personalised support to student queries and issues.

LINC Fellows will be expected to promptly interact with students over email, or calls / online sessions from locations of their convenience (e.g. home, office etc.).

title: Offering Tools Finance Lead
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Offering Tools Finance Lead

Purpose

Everpure is looking for a Business Case Finance Lead to build the financial models behind customer business cases. You will build CFO-grade, repeatable and standardised value logic for products across Everpure's portfolio, and own the assumptions, benchmarks and inputs that keep those models accurate. The models feed directly into our wider automated sales operating model, so sellers everywhere present customers with the same credible, defensible numbers.

These models will underpin the proposals used across the entire sales organisation, and form the core of the business cases that go in front of customers. They will cover a wide range of deal sizes, products and industries, so they need to be consistent, robust and adaptable.

The role has three parts:

• Identify the value. Understand how each product creates measurable value for customers, across cost efficiency, growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.

• Build the model. Convert that value into a repeatable, standardised financial model, including cash flow, P&L and return metrics, that works across accounts and deal sizes.

• Tell the financial story. Translate the model and its outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that increases the impact of every proposal with customers, including their CFOs and finance teams.

What Success Looks Like

• Credible, robust and accurate financial models underpin the portfolio of Everpure products.

• Models are repeatable and standardised, and can be fed into customer proposals through our wider automated operating model.

• Models and financials are translated into a compelling financial narrative that resonates with customers, including CFOs and finance teams.

• Governance is in place around model inputs, with assumptions validated, updated and maintained.

• Existing models are continually refined as new data is collected and new products are released.

What You'll Be Doing

Value and Financial Models

• Identify how each product creates measurable value for customers across the key value levers: cost efficiency, revenue growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.

• Build CFO-grade financial models, including cash flow and P&L, for each product across the portfolio.

• Standardise models around common inputs and outputs, so they can be repeated efficiently and consistently across accounts and products.

• Apply a consistent methodology and accounting treatment, with ROI, TCO, NPV, IRR and payback calculated the same way every time.

• Continuously improve model accuracy, and develop new, financially robust ways to quantify value.

Financial Narrative

• Translate model outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that shows customers what the investment means for their business.

• Turn complex financial results into tangible measures that customers and sellers can relate to.

• Help sellers position the business case confidently, in executive language.

Assumptions, Inputs and Governance

• Own, govern and maintain the global assumptions, benchmarks and financial inputs feeding the models.

• Identify and add the new pricing, product advances and market trends the models need, within an agreed SLA.

• Define the source, owner and refresh cadence for every input, and maintain a clear version history.

• Reconcile model outputs against real deals to check accuracy over time.

We offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for growth, where you can contribute to helping millions achieve better health through education, premium supplements, and holistic practices like the Healthy Keto® diet.

We’re looking for a YouTube Copywriter who can optimize our videos, making them easier to find, whether people search on Google, browse YouTube, or ask an AI assistant like ChatGPT or Gemini. title: Backend Engineer, Security
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We are expanding the Marketplace Security domain and looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join an established team dedicated to enabling member security in Vinted.

As a backend software engineer, you will play a key role in driving technical initiatives, building new services, developing and maintaining features. Your main aim will be preparing the product for technical challenges ahead, ensuring Vinted members feel safe on the platform, and contributing to the Vinted vision of making second-hand the first choice. By joining Vinted you will become part of an active community of engineers who are exceptional at delivering the highest grade solutions and are keen on sharing knowledge.

Here are some of the technologies we use:

• Programming languages: Go, Ruby

• Datastores: MySQL with Vitess, Redis

• Observability: Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK stack

• Streaming platform: Kafka

• CI/CD: Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Jenkins

• Auth: Okta, OAuth, Open Policy Agent

In this position, you’ll 

• Work in a cross-functional team, contribute to team and domain-level initiatives, and shape the features to improve security for Vinted members.

• Transform large monoliths into smaller, component-based services, thereby promoting greater team autonomy.

• Work on malicious actors prevention and mitigation.

• Monitor and ensure the reliability of your code.

• See your code affect millions of members almost instantly.

About you 

• You have hands-on work experience in development or operations at scale. Bonus points for experience in the cybersecurity domain.

• You are driven by curiosity to explore and master new technologies and concepts.

• You are aware of the newest AI solutions and can pick the best one to improve your role effectiveness.

• You are committed to writing clean, maintainable code with a focus on accuracy and quality.

• You have a strong inclination to collaborate with team members, share knowledge and foster a positive, cooperative environment.

• You are a good communicator, able to get your point across in spoken and written English in diverse contexts.

Work perks 

• The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

• 25 working days of holiday

• Access to all the tools & tech needed for work

• Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

• Private health insurance

• Pension plan with flexible contribution options and a matching contributio

title: Senior Product Manager (CRM & Growth)
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Every email and notification we send is part of how customers experience Lendable, and a 5.0★ Trustpilot rating across more than 100,000 reviews sets a high bar for it: communication has to be clear, timely and honest. As our Senior Product Manager for CRM & Growth, you'll own the products and systems that shape how customers hear from us across their lifecycle, from first interaction through to retention and reactivation.

Product here isn't backlog grooming. The trade-offs are commercial as much as they are user-facing: engagement, retention, conversion, cost to serve and customer experience all pull against each other, and you'll make the calls. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, so sharp prioritisation is central to the job. The role also has a real technical edge. Messaging reliability, deliverability and platform integrations are part of what you'll own, so you'll need to be comfortable going deep with engineers. Teams here are small relative to the size of the book we run, so you'll carry more scope and ownership than the same title would at a larger, more layered company.

What you'll be doing

- Owning the roadmap and outcomes for our CRM and lifecycle product: onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation

- Prioritising a pipeline of competing opportunities across CRM, growth, deliverability and platform work, weighing expected impact, effort and risk, and being clear about what we won't do

- Taking products and channel improvements from problem definition through to launch and iteration, owning both the product and technical decisions alongside Engineering

- Defining the metrics that matter and making the commercial trade-offs between growth, retention, cost and customer experience, and making sure performance is measurable end to end, from tracking and data flows through to dashboards the wider business can trust

- Running an experimentation programme: writing clear hypotheses, designing A/B tests, and using SQL and our data to measure true incremental impact

- Treating email deliverability and messaging reliability as product concerns, working with Engineering on infrastructure, platform integrations and cost efficiency

- Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender

- Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.

What we're looking for

ESSENTIAL

- 5+ ye

title: Strategic Account Manager, Hospital
description:

Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.

The Acute Care Technology division of ZOLL Medical Corporation develops and delivers innovative lifesaving products and software solutions to EMS, hospital, public safety, and military customers globally. Products include AEDs, trauma kits, ventilators, temperature management solutions, and more. Our dedicated employees take pride in their commitment to improving patient outcomes while delivering world-class customer service.

At ZOLL, you won’t just have a job. You'll have a career-and a purpose.

Join our team. It’s a great time to be a part of ZOLL!

Job Summary

The Strategic Account Manager will be charged with advancing ZOLL's Strategic positioning within Key Accounts, strategically important geographies, strategically important competitive accounts, and large account opportunities. The Strategic Account Manager will be responsible to advance ZOLL's position in these geographies and accounts. This individual will report directly to the Senior Director - Strategic Accounts, U.S. Hospital Sales

Essential Functions

• Penetrate the top layers of the larger, complex accounts in an effort to gain support from the top down

• Penetrate accounts, markets, competitive accounts and geographies and turn key decision makers towards ZOLL

• Create the opportunity for cross over selling across market segments (Hospital/TMS/Life Vest and EMS/ZDS), to create incremental revenue and to strategically advance ZOLL's position in the market

• Work as a team with the Sales Representatives and Regional Managers

• Sell ZOLL's solutions in the Executive Offices of a Healthcare Organization, as well as clinicians, code committees and others throughout the healthcare system

• Finding and closing significant business opportunities, which should have a strategic impact on ZOLL.

Required/Preferred Education and Experience

• B.A/B.S. Degree preferred

• Must have at least 10 years of successful selling experience into the US healthcare markets. required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Extensive capital medical equipment experience preferable.

• Demonstrated success selling systems, concepts and solutions at the administrative levels of a healthcare organization.

• Advanced computer skills.

• Organization and Time Management skills.

• Strong communication skills.

ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients's lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Join us in our efforts to improve outcomes for underserved patients suffering from critical cardiopulmonary conditions and help save more lives. $300,000.00 which includes a base salary of $90,000.00 and commission in accordance with the company's sales compensation plan. Details of ZOLL's comprehensive benefits plans can be found at .

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. • Mentor/lead junior validation team members and QA staff on validation methodologies and documentation best practices.

• Serve as Luma subject matter expert for GAMP5, 21 CFR Part, EU Annex 11, and applicable ISO standards.

• Provide validation guidance and training to engineers, QA analysts, and project managers on CSV principles, IQ/OQ/PQ expectations, and 21 CFR Part 11 controls.

We are looking for people who can support customer-facing validation activities, coordinate validation testing and defect resolution, assist with CAPA investigations and audit responses, and collaborate with the Quality Management team to maintain document control, periodic reviews, and overall audit readiness for validation artefacts.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!

If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb .io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:
Product marketing at Honeycomb is a small team with a wide surface area. We decide how Honeycomb is positioned, what we say at launch, what the sales team brings into a deal, and how an engineer who has never heard of us understands the product in the first two minutes. Because the team is small, the work is broad: in one week you might rewrite a product page, build a competitive one-pager, interview a customer, and run the launch checklist for a new feature.
This role is built for someone early in a product marketing career who wants to systematically improve the customer buying journey. As a product and messaging expert, you will partner with go-to-market teams to drive business impact through sales and marketing campaigns. You will get real ownership of real launches, and you will have senior product marketers, a technical field team, and engineers who like explaining their work close at hand. Our audience is engineers and platform teams, so the bar is accuracy first: we would rather be precise and useful than clever.
What you’ll do in the role:
You will support and execute product marketing across Honeycomb 's core products, with a generalist mix of messaging, launches, content, enablement, and competitive work. Expect to start by contributing to pieces of each and to own more of them over your first year.
Responsibilities

•
Messaging and positioning: Write and maintain messaging for features and product areas, from the one-sentence version an engineer reads on a web page to the slide a sales engineer uses in a technical conversation. Keep it accurate and grounded in what the product actually does.

•
Launches: Run launch execution for small and mid-sized releases and support the larger ones. Build the plan, write the assets, coordinate Product, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success, and report on how the launch performed.

•
Content: Produce the practical material that helps people evaluate and adopt Honeycomb : blog posts, solution briefs, web copy, demo scripts, FAQs, and customer-facing one-pagers.

•
Sales enablement: Equip the field with what they need to run a good conversation, including pitch narratives, objection handling, battlecards, and release updates. Join customer calls, listen to recorded ones, and fix the material that isn't landing.

•
Competitive and market intelligence: Track the observability market and competitor moves. Maintain competitive assets and keep them current and honest, so the field trusts them.

•
Voice of customer and proof points: Talk to customers and prospects, turn what you hear into case studies, quotes, and proof points, and bring the patterns back to Product and Marketing.

•
Measurement: Help define what success looks like for your work, pull the data, and share

- Drive vulnerability remediation end to end: triage, prioritize, and automate fixes, partnering with the rest of the DevOps team on production rollout.

- Build automated scanning and remediation into our pipelines.

- Tune WAF policies and the OWASP Core Rule Set to protect public-facing applications without blocking legitimate traffic.

- Run PCI DSS vulnerability scanning, including quarterly external ASV scans, and drive remediation of findings.

- Contribute to incident response planning and exercises, and ensure backups and recovery processes meet security requirements for encryption, access, and integrity.

- Produce and automate evidence for technical controls, and keep our cloud environments connected to our compliance platform (Drata).

- Serve as technical expert for audits, customer security reviews, and vendor assessments involving sensitive data.

- 3+ years in DevSecOps, security engineering, cloud security, or a closely related role

- Hands-on experience securing GCP and/or AWS, including managed Kubernetes (GKE, EKS)

title: Senior Systems Engineer - Commissioning and Characterisation

Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale. 

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence.

You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements.

Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.

You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known.

We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems.

title: Construction Superintendent, Fluid/Mechanical - Memphis
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

CONSTRUCTION SUPERINTENDENT, FLUID/MECHANICAL

Most construction jobs manage someone else’s crew on someone else’s schedule, then end when the project does. This one does not.

SpaceX builds its own launch sites, factories, test stands, and AI superclusters - and it plans to keep building. The rockets, the chips, and the missions only matter if the ground under them is real. Construction is how that ground gets built, in-house and to a standard the company can actually use. The work does not dry up between jobs. There is a next site, and one after that. You lead the crew that builds them.

You own a self-performing team. Foremen run their people day to day. You run the foremen. You are in the dirt, walking the work, setting the bar, and clearing whatever is in the way. When someone is ready for more, you say so. When the standard slips, you deal with it.

Scope includes, but not limited to industrial HVAC, pipefitting, pipe welding, chilled water, cooling towers, chillers, condensers, CRAC and CRAH units, and setting that heavy mechanical equipment. It also includes all plumbing: domestic water, sanitary, drain-waste-vent, and floor drains. It includes all fire protection: sprinkler fitting, suppression, and pre-action. This is the work that moves heat, water, and fire protection through the building.

The team goes where the next site is - a pad, a factory, a supercluster, whatever has to exist before the rest of the company can move. Right now that is Memphis, TN / Southaven, MS. Then it is the next one. Per diem comes with the assignment.

• Remove roadblocks so crews can keep working: materials, access, sequencing, coordination with other trades, and decisions

• Recommend promotions, role changes, and corrective action based on performance

• Plan and run the night-shift assignment, including extended hours, as part of a 24/7 operation

• Track daily progress and maintain logs, red-line drawings, and as-built documentation for mechanical, plumbing, and fire-protection systems

• Build and hold an aggressive construction schedule, on time and within budget

• Champion SpaceXSI’s safety program and a zero-incident culture around pressure piping, hot work, rigging and setting heavy mechanical equipment, and work at heights

• Resolve on-site issues - material delays, technical conflicts, sequencing, and trade coordination - with attention to system integrity and code compliance

title: Research Engineer, Benchmarks & Evaluation
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT RAMP LABS

Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 70,000+ companies use to move money. We think the defensible part of an AI product is the loop: proprietary environments, evals that track what customers care about, and models trained against both.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every model decision at Ramp Labs runs through a benchmark. Which model to route to. Whether a post-training run worked. Whether an agent is ready to post a corrective journal entry to a customer's ledger without a human in the loop.

You'll own Ramp's benchmarking effort. You'll turn real finance work (expense policy review, invoice coding, month-end close, spreadsheet Q&A) into benchmarks and RL environments, build the graders, and tell the team what is actually improving.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build benchmarks from real workflows: turn agent traces, customer edge cases and expert labels into versioned benchmark suites for long-horizon agents that run for hours across tools and systems, plus tool use, multi-step reasoning and financial judgment

- Own the benchmarking effort: decide what we measure, run benchmark suites across models and agent versions, and report results the team makes decisions on

- Design graders: rubrics, programmatic checks and llm-as-judge, calibrated against human agreement, with a clear view of where each one breaks

- Close the loop with post-training: turn evals into reward functions and RL environments, and catch reward hacking and contamination before they ship

- Publish external benchmarks and write-ups on how models perform at real finance work

WHAT YOU NEED

- Hands-on experience building LLM benchmarks or evals that people used to make real decisions

- Strong Python and software engineering; your eval code is reproducible and fast

- Statistical judgment: variance, confidence intervals, sample size, inter-rater agreement, and knowing when a delta is noise

- Working knowledge of post-training (SFT, RL with verifiable rewards) and how evals feed into it

- Comfort with SQL and large datasets; you'll work directly from production traces

- Taste for what is worth measuring

NICE-TO-HAVE

- Industry experience on an eval, benchmarking or post-training team

- Built RL environments or verifiers for agentic tasks

- Published benchmark or evaluation research (NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks, ICML, ACL)

- Built or contributed to eval frameworks (verifiers, lm-evaluation-harness, HELM or similar)

- Familiarity with accounting, finance or other expert-domain work

- Public work we can look at: a benchmark, an eval suite, a failure-analysis write-up

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual

Job Title: Senior Safety Domain Expert - Falcon
Job Location: Boston, MA
Job Location Type: Remote

Job Seniority Level:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced pharmacovigilance professional to serve as our Senior Safety Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. This role bridges ground-level case execution with macro-level safety operations, using your deep knowledge of case processing, MedDRA coding, database reconciliation, and global compliance to inform our AI driven automation tools. You will spend your days collaborating with our internal technical teams and external early adopters, acting as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to ensure our platform delivers flawless safety automation.
What You'll Do

End-to-End Workflow Guidance: Advise product and engineering teams on the detailed steps of safety case intake, triage, validation, and advanced data reconciliation workflows

Ground-Truth Verification: Actively review and verify platform outputs across initial data entry, automated MedDRA coding assignment, and generated follow-up queries to ensure absolute data precision

Requirements

• 5+ years of active experience in Pharmacovigilance / Drug Safety Operations

• High proficiency with MedDRA coding rules and deep familiarity with mainstream safety databases (e.g., Veeva Safety, Argus, ArisG)

• Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to confidently present operational perspectives to non-clinical technical partners and customers

Nice to Have

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

title: M&A – Praktikum / Intern (m/w/d)
description:
DEINE ROLLE

Die Steuerberatung erlebt eine Konsolidierungswelle: Tausende Häuser suchen in den nächsten Jahren eine Nachfolge, und nur wenige Käufer prüfen sie mit derselben Sorgfalt wie ein professionelles Transaktionsteam. Hier lernst du M&A auf der Käuferseite, an echten Transaktionen und von der ersten Ansprache bis nach dem Abschluss.

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen und erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen, um sie weiterzuentwickeln. Wir prüfen laufend neue Ziele, bewerten, verhandeln und schließen ab. Anders als bei einem Finanzinvestor endet unsere Arbeit nicht beim Abschluss, sie fängt dort an.

Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor oder im Master und willst den Transaktionsprozess vollständig kennenlernen, nicht nur einen Ausschnitt davon. Das Praktikum dauert drei bis sechs Monate in Vollzeit. Du arbeitest im Finance-Team und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung an laufenden Transaktionen.

DEINE VERANTWORTUNG

Zielsuche und Marktanalyse

- Du baust Longlists und Shortlists möglicher Ziele, recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Nachfolgesituationen und bereitest Erstansprachen vor.

- Du wertest Teaser und erste Unterlagen aus und hältst in einer kurzen Einschätzung fest, ob sich eine vertiefte Prüfung lohnt.

Bewertung und Due Diligence

- Du erstellst Bewertungen nach Multiplikatoren, Transaktionsvergleichen und Ertragswert, normalisierst Jahresabschlüsse und rechnest Kaufpreis-Mechanik und Sensitivitäten durch.

- Du strukturierst Datenräume, koordinierst Fragenlisten mit dem Verkäufer und unseren Beratern und benennst Auffälligkeiten für die Verhandlung.

- Du rechnest die Finanzierungsseite mit: Kapitaldienst, Rückbeteiligung, Zahlungsstruktur über die Zeit.

Verhandlung und Abschluss

- Du bereitest Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung vor: eine Empfehlung mit Begründung, keine Sammlung von Kennzahlen.

- Du arbeitest an Absichtserklärungen, Term Sheets und Verhandlungsunterlagen mit und begleitest Gespräche mit Inhabern.

- Nach dem Abschluss hilfst du, das übernommene Haus in unser Berichtswesen zu überführen, und machst sichtbar, ob die Annahmen der Bewertung eintreten.

DEINE PERSPEKTIVEN

Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast:

- Du hast an mindestens einer Transaktion durchgehend mitgearbeitet, von der Analyse bis zur Verhandlung.

- Ein Bewertungsmodell von dir ist in eine Entscheidungsvorlage eingegangen, und ein Dritter kann es weiterrechnen.

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

- Du trägst die Erstprüfung eines Ziels eigenständig, vom Teaser bis zur Empfehlung.

- Du kennst den Prozess so gut, dass du die nächste Prüfung strukturieren könntest.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Wer im Praktikum überzeugt, hat die Tür für den Einstieg in Finance & M&A offen. Fachliche Expertenlaufbahn und Führungslaufbahn stehen danach beide offen, entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

Erfahrung & Track Record

- Fortgeschrittenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Fach mit Vertiefung in Finance, Corporate Finance oder Rechnungswesen.

- Erste Praxis in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Private Equity oder einer Unternehmensberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

- Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen. Konkret: Steuerfachangestellte mit laufendem Studium, die Jahresabschlüsse von innen kennen, Mathematik- oder Physikstudierende mit Interesse an Bewertung, Gründer eines eigenen kleinen Unternehmens. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

- Du bist sicher in Excel und PowerPoint und baust Modelle, die ein Dritter verstehen und weiterrechnen kann.

- Du liest einen Jahresabschluss so, dass du erkennst, was erklärungsbedürftig ist, statt Kennz

When an agency or billing company buys Logis Billing, the first months decide whether it trusts us. If the setup is right, claims go out clean and cash arrives on time. If it is wrong, claims reject, payments do not post, and the customer feels it in their bank account.
You take a customer from kickoff to their first clean billing cycle. You learn how they bill today, configure Logis Billing to match, move their data, train their staff, and stay with them through go-live until the money is moving. Then you hand them off cleanly to support and Customer Success.

title: GPU Engineer
description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. title: Integration & Solution Specialist - Welfare
description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users.

We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what’s broken - you’ll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you’ll build something worth being proud of.

What you’ll be doing

As our Integration & Solution Specialist - Welfare, you’ll turn the needs of clients and partners into integrations that work, taking each one from the first discovery call to go-live.

Here’s what that looks like in practice:

- Discovery - Lead discovery with clients and partners. Turn business needs and constraints into functional requirements and integration setups that last (API, file exchange, automations).

- Flow design - Design and document end-to-end flows in detail: data mapping, frequency, controls, exception handling and technical deliverables, working side by side with the development teams.

- Project management - Run integrations from start to finish. Set milestones, assign responsibilities, coordinate across teams, and keep track of progress, risks and dependencies.

- Testing and go-live - Oversee testing, validation and go-live. Handle blockers and escalations quickly, and hand over smoothly to the teams that run and support the integration day to day.

- Standardisation - Create guidelines, reusable templates and checklists, so delivery scales with less complexity and fewer custom interventions.

- Partner onboarding - Onboard and integrate strategic partners, merchants and HR/welfare platforms, keeping business logic and information systems aligned.

- Flexible benefits flows - Map and improve the operational flows of the flexible benefits ecosystem between Satispay, client companies and providers: employee records, allocations, transactions, reporting and data reconciliation.

- Sales and partnerships support - Support the sales and partnerships teams in qualifying opportunities, checking technical and functional feasibility and operational constraints before commercial agreements are signed.

- Continuous improvement - Collect recurring patterns and needs from the welfare ecosystem, spot what can be automated, and help improve product features.

Who we’re looking for

This role needs someone who takes an integration from the first requirements to a smooth go-live, and is just as comfortable talking to technical and non-technical people.

- Experience - At least 3 years managing B2B integrations, from requirements gathering to go-live.

- Functional analysis - Process mapping and design of end-to-end operational flows.

- Integration know-how - Familiarity with APIs, file exchange, data mapping, authentication and data quality checks.

- Communication - You talk with technical and non-technical people, and weight constraints, alternatives and operational impact. You don’t need to be a developer.

- Autonomy - You handle standard integrations on your own, love solving problems, and ask for support on the most complex cases.

- Organisation - Good organisational skills and a knack for managing priorities.

- Nice to have - Experience in the welfare ecosystem, flexible benefits, HR tech or payroll, in standardising and automating integration processes, and in managing external vendors and partners and coordinating cross-functional projects.

title: Principal Product Manager, Fraud and Cybersecurity
description:
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote, Lahore Pakistan

About the Role
This role is based in Lahore, Pakistan. You will own the product direction for Pixalate's fraud and privacy products: how invalid traffic (IVT) is defined and labeled, how supply chain verification is applied, the fraud datafeeds clients use to block bad traffic, and the COPPA and privacy products. You will turn what the fraud team finds in impression-level data into shipped detection, reporting and datafeeds.
You will work daily with the fraud team and engineering, and with Customer Success when a change affects what clients see in their reports and blocklists. This is a hands-on product role. You write the requirements, check the data behind them, test the results before release, and explain the change to clients and to the team.
This is not a program management role, and it is not a pure compliance or policy role. You are expected to understand how fraud works well enough to argue about a detection signal with the people who found it.

What You'll Do

• Own the IVT taxonomy: define new IVT types, set their priority and naming, and decide how they appear in the dashboard, the API and scheduled reports alongside the legacy types.

• Take new fraud detection from research to release: write requirements for the fraud pipeline, set the false-positive bar, run user acceptance testing and agree the rollout sequence.

• Own supply chain object (SCO) verification: define how unauthorized and incomplete sellers are flagged, as an IVT type or a metric.

• Own the fraud datafeeds (IP, device ID, mobile and CTV): define what belongs in each feed, the evidence rules and guardrails, and what clients should expect when a feed changes.

• Own the COPPA and privacy products: define the classifications, reports and API modules that clients use to find child-directed and non-compliant apps, and answer client questions on how they work.

• Estimate the client impact of every change with SQL before it ships, and plan the messaging with Customer Success.

• Write one-pagers, requirements and release plans, and keep the roadmap current with engineering and the program team.

• Work with the fraud team on investigations, and help turn findings into product features, client explanations and public research.

What You Bring

Required:

• 7+ years in product management, including 3+ years on cybersecurity, fraud detection or threat intelligence products.

• Cybersecurity experience: you have owned a security, fraud or threat detection product and can explain the signals it used and why they mattered.

• A degree in computer science, engineering or another technical field.

• Cambridge O Levels or A Levels, or an equivalent.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, assessed with a written exercise.

• SQL and comfort analyzing large datasets to size the impact of a product change.

• Working knowledge of web and network fundamentals: IP addressing, HTTP, DNS, proxies.

• Comfortable working across time zones, with regular overlap with US business hours.

Preferred:

• A degree from an international university.

• Knowledge of COPPA, GDPR and other children's privacy rules, and experience turning them into product requirements.

• Ad tech experience: programmatic, CTV and mobile advertising, SSPs and DSPs.

• Familiarity with the MRC IVT guidelines and IAB Tech Lab standards (ads.txt, sellers.json, SupplyChain object).

• Experience running datafeeds, blocklists or APIs as products.

• Security certifications such as CISSP or CEH, or a CIPP privacy credential.

• Published blogs, reports or talks on fraud, security or privacy.

About Pixalate

We're the leader in fraud detection and privacy compliance for digital advertising, protecting billions in ad spend for Fortune 500 brands, major ad platforms, consumers, and children from deceptive, fraudulent, and non-compliant mobile and CTV apps. As fraudsters increasingly use AI to create sophisticated attacks

title: Introduction to Bioinformatics, Department of Applied Sciences and Professional
description:

Applied Sciences and Professional Studies | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC)

This position is specifically to teach remotely, for stateside applicants . Local applicants only; UMGC does not sponsor logistical support for this role.

Introduction to Bioinformatics (BIOT 630):
An introduction to bioinformatics. Emphasis is on the interpretation of data. Topics include new, sophisticated DNA, RNA, and protein sequence analyses and pattern recognition and DNA computing, as well as more traditional mathematical modeling (using Bayesian probability and basic algorithms, machine learning and neural networks, and Markov models and dynamic programming).
